# Image Parsing via MiMo-V2.5

> 基于 opencode 的 skill + `mode: subagent` + Task 机制编写并测试通过;该模式理论上可迁移到其他支持 skill/subagent 的 agent,但需按目标工具调整配置。

If your current model can read images directly (it has image input), just handle the image yourself and skip this skill.

Otherwise — when the user's request involves an image and your model is text-only — follow this flow:

1. Locate the image. It may be an attached image in the current turn or a historical message, or a local file path in the conversation/project.
2. If the image is a file part in the conversation history, determine its source from its `filename`:
   - Real absolute path that exists on disk (drag-in) → use that path directly.
   - Placeholder basename or empty (e.g. `image.png`) with a `data:image/...;base64,...` URL (clipboard paste) → no disk file exists. Decode the base64 payload from the `url` and write it to a temp file in the system temp directory, then use that path.
   - If you can't see the part's `filename`/`url`, ask the user to re-attach the image.
3. Call the Task tool to delegate image parsing to the `mimo-vision` subagent (a vision-capable MiMo-V2.5 model; the default config uses `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free` — free via `opencode auth login`):
   - `description`: "Parse image with MiMo-V2.5"
   - `subagent_type`: `mimo-vision`
   - `prompt`: give the absolute image file path(s) and state precisely what the user wants extracted (text/OCR, description, code from a screenshot, table data, UI layout, etc.).
4. The subagent reads the image and returns a detailed text description.
5. Use that parsed text to answer the user. You may quote, transcribe, or reason over it as needed.

Do not ask the user to switch models or re-paste the image — the delegate handles it.

## 输出简洁原则

执行图片解析时,保持可见输出极简,不要逐句叙述技术细节(如 base64 解码、临时文件路径、会话库提取、脚本执行)。只保留简短状态行,例如:

> 识别到图片(粘贴/本地路径) → 调用 mimo-vision 识别 → 已识别完成 → 继续处理

工具调用本身会让过程可见,无需再用文字解释每一步。直接在解析结果上继续回答用户的原始问题即可。

## 模型不可用时

如果 `mimo-vision` 子代理调用失败(如 provider 未配置/未授权):
- 免费用户:运行 `opencode auth login` 获取 OpenCode Zen 的 key(默认模型 `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free` 免费且支持图片)。
- 或者按 README 把 `agent/mimo-vision.md` 里的 `model` 换成用户自己可用的视觉模型。
- 简短告知用户即可,不要卡住任务。

# opencode-image-parsing

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> ⚠️ This project is built on opencode's **skill + subagent** mechanism and **tested on opencode**. The mechanism itself is a general pattern — other agent frameworks with skill/subagent support (e.g. Claude Code) may work **in theory**, but the config paths, frontmatter fields, and model IDs (e.g. `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free`) are written for opencode. Adapt them to the target tool when migrating.

Let **text-only models** (e.g. DeepSeek V4 Flash) "see" images, via a skill + subagent.

When the model cannot parse an image, it automatically delegates the parsing to **MiMo-V2.5** (a vision-capable model), then continues answering based on the parsed text. Your chosen text model stays as the main model — only the "look at the image" step goes through MiMo.

## How it works

```
Text-only model (can't see images)
   │  skill "image-parsing" triggers
   ▼
Task invokes subagent mimo-vision (model: MiMo-V2.5)
   │  reads the image file with the Read tool
   ▼
Returns a detailed text description of the image
   ▼
Text-only model answers based on that text
```

- **Local images (drag & drop)** → the file path is passed directly to the subagent.
- **Clipboard-pasted images** → the base64 payload is decoded from the conversation data into a temp file, then passed to the subagent.

## One-line install

**Windows (PowerShell)**:

```powershell
$d = "$HOME\.config\opencode"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$d\agent", "$d\skills\image-parsing" -Force | Out-Null
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/agent/mimo-vision.md" -OutFile "$d\agent\mimo-vision.md"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md" -OutFile "$d\skills\image-parsing\SKILL.md"
```

**macOS / Linux (bash/zsh)**:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/skills/image-parsing ~/.config/opencode/agent
curl -fsSL -o ~/.config/opencode/agent/mimo-vision.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/agent/mimo-vision.md
curl -fsSL -o ~/.config/opencode/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md
```

Restart **opencode** after installing.

## Manual install

Copy `skills/image-parsing/` and `agent/mimo-vision.md` to either location (or both):

**Global install** (all projects):

```
~/.config/opencode/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md
~/.config/opencode/agent/mimo-vision.md
```

**Project-level install**:

```
.opencode/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md
.opencode/agent/mimo-vision.md
```

## Auth (free)

The default subagent uses `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free`:

```
opencode auth login
```

One login gives you a free OpenCode Zen key. The model is **free** and supports image input — no opencode-go subscription needed.

## Switching models

To use a different model, change the `model` field in `agent/mimo-vision.md`:

| Scenario | model |
|---|---|
| Default (free) | `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free` |
| opencode-go subscriber | `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5` |
| Kenari (free tier) | `kenari/mimo-v2-5:free` |
| Xiaomi official API (key required) | `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` |

> Restart opencode after changing the config.

## In action

After pasting a screenshot, the model outputs something like:

> Image detected (pasted) → invoking mimo-vision → parsed → continuing...
>
> This is an e-commerce product page: title "xxx", price ¥xx, xx in stock...

## Notes

- Internal details (base64 decoding, temp files, conversation-data extraction) are kept out of the output.
- If the subagent's model is not authorized, it will prompt you to run `opencode auth login` or switch models — it won't get stuck.

# opencode-image-parsing

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

> ⚠️ 本项目基于 opencode 的 **skill + 子代理(subagent)** 机制编写,并已在 opencode 中**测试通过**。该机制本身是通用模式——其他支持技能与子代理的 agent 框架(如 Claude Code)**理论上也支持**,但配置路径、frontmatter 字段、模型 ID(`opencode/mimo-v2.5-free`)等为 opencode 编写,迁移到其他工具时需按目标工具做相应调整。

让**纯文本模型**(如 DeepSeek V4 Flash)也能"看图"的技能(skill) + 子代理(subagent)方案。

当模型无法直接解析图片时,自动把图片解析委托给 **MiMo-V2.5**(支持图片输入的视觉模型),再基于解析结果继续回答。主模型保持你选定的文本模型不变,只有"看图片"这一步走 mimo。

## 工作原理

```
文本模型(不认图)
   │  skill「image-parsing」触发
   ▼
Task 调用子代理 mimo-vision(model: 视觉模型 MiMo-V2.5)
   │  用 Read 工具读取图片文件
   ▼
返回图片内容的详细文字描述
   ▼
文本模型基于文字继续回答
```

- **拖入的本地图片** → 直接把磁盘路径交给子代理。
- **剪贴板粘贴的图片** → 先从会话数据里解码 base64 落盘为临时文件,再交给子代理。

## 一键安装

**Windows(PowerShell)**:

```powershell
$d = "$HOME\.config\opencode"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$d\agent", "$d\skills\image-parsing" -Force | Out-Null
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/agent/mimo-vision.md" -OutFile "$d\agent\mimo-vision.md"
Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md" -OutFile "$d\skills\image-parsing\SKILL.md"
```

**macOS / Linux(bash/zsh)**:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.config/opencode/skills/image-parsing ~/.config/opencode/agent
curl -fsSL -o ~/.config/opencode/agent/mimo-vision.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/agent/mimo-vision.md
curl -fsSL -o ~/.config/opencode/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md https://raw.githubusercontent.com/starstarstars/opencode-image-parsing/main/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md
```

安装后**重启 opencode** 生效。

## 手动安装

把仓库里的 `skills/image-parsing/` 和 `agent/mimo-vision.md` 复制到以下任一位置(二选一或都放):

**全局安装**(所有项目生效):

```
~/.config/opencode/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md
~/.config/opencode/agent/mimo-vision.md
```

**项目级安装**:

```
.opencode/skills/image-parsing/SKILL.md
.opencode/agent/mimo-vision.md
```

## 授权(免费即可用)

默认子代理使用 `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free`:

```
opencode auth login
```

登录一次即可获得 OpenCode Zen 的免费 key,该模型**免费**且支持图片输入,无需订阅 opencode-go。

## 切换模型

不需要默认模型的话,改 `agent/mimo-vision.md` 里的 `model` 字段即可:

| 场景 | model |
|---|---|
| 默认(免费) | `opencode/mimo-v2.5-free` |
| 有 opencode-go 订阅 | `opencode-go/mimo-v2.5` |
| Kenari(免费档) | `kenari/mimo-v2-5:free` |
| 小米官方 API(需 key) | `xiaomi/mimo-v2.5` |

> 修改配置后需重启 opencode 生效。

## 使用效果

粘贴一张截图后,模型会输出类似:

> 识别到图片(粘贴)→ 调用 mimo-vision 识别 → 已识别完成 → 继续处理
>
> 这是一张电商商品页截图:标题「xxx」,价格 ¥xx,库存 xx 件……

## 其他

- 内部技术细节(解码 base64、临时文件、会话库提取)不会在输出中啰嗦展开。
- 如果子代理的模型未授权,会提示你 `opencode auth login` 或换模型,不会卡住任务。

---
description: Vision-capable subagent running MiMo-V2.5. Reads and parses images (screenshots, photos, diagrams, charts, scanned documents). Only invoked for image parsing, never for other work.
mode: subagent
model: opencode/mimo-v2.5-free
temperature: 0.2
---

You are a vision-capable model running MiMo-V2.5. Your only job is to parse images and return their content as text.

The calling agent gives you the absolute file path of one or more images in the Task prompt.

Steps:
1. Use the Read tool on each image path to load it. (The Read tool returns the image to you as a file attachment — you can see it.)
2. Carefully examine the image and extract everything the caller needs:
   - All visible text, verbatim (OCR).
   - Layout / structure / UI elements and their states.
   - Objects, people, scenes, or domain content.
   - Tables, formulas, diagrams, charts and their data points.
3. Return a complete, structured text description. Do not summarize away detail the caller asked for — reproduce text and data exactly.

If the image cannot be loaded or is unreadable, say so explicitly rather than guessing.
